name: FUN_SPM_SQL_BASELINES
description: This table contains the state of baselines created through SQL plan management to associate an individual SQL statement with a plan.

columns.name: SQL_BASELINE_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence generated identifier for the SQL Plan baseline.

columns.name: SQL_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the SQL instance that the SQL baseline is associated with.

columns.name: SQL_PLAN_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the SQL plan Instance that the SQL baseline is associated with.

columns.name: RDBMS_PLAN_NAME
columns.description: Unique plan identifier in string form that is used as a search key.

columns.name: SEED_CUSTOM_PLAN_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the desired custom plan action code from seed data.

columns.name: SEED_SPM_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the desired SPM baseline enabled status.

columns.name: CURRENT_SPM_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the current SPM baseline enabled status.

columns.name: SEED_PLAN_RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Result code of the seeded base-lined plan status from the latest execution.

columns.name: CUSTOM_PLAN_RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Result code of the custom base-lined plan status from the latest execution.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
